msg_id.description: Message ID from check or search, or several separated by commas (for read)

attachment.description: Optional (for send): /_upload/… URL of a file from THIS conversation to attach (an uploaded image, or sandbox output like a PDF). Embedding in the body and attaching can be combined, also for the same image.

line_start.description: First line to read, 1-based (for read and attachment). Use with line_end, or to go on where a long text ended.

line_end.description: Last line to read, inclusive; 0 = to the end (for read and attachment)

pages.description: Scanned PDF pages to show, like 3 or 1-5 or 3,7,10-12 (for attachment)

n.description: Number of newest emails to list (for check and search, default 20)

unread.description: Only unread emails, all of them unless n is given (for check)

body.description: Email body as Markdown (for send). Files from THIS conversation are addressed by their /_upload/… URL: ![alt](URL) embeds an image in the text, [name](URL) attaches the file.
